messages:
Alex Ruiz: Postmortem follow-up: we've seen recurring 'stutter' where streams deliver partial tokens, pause ~2-6s, then resume. Suspect handshake/reconnect + rate-limiter + KV cache cold starts. Assigning owners for fixes/observability.

Maria Ng: I'll add an inter_chunk_gap_ms metric per session, 95p/median histograms, and an alert if 95p > 3000ms over 10m. Dashboard + link by EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I'll instrument runtime reconnect logic. Plan: canary extend handshake timeout 2s->6s, detect if reconnect triggers KV-cache cold reseed, and try skipping reseed for reconnects within 10s. ETA: Fri AM.

Sarah Li: I'll prep a customer-facing note draft in case beta users are impacted. Hold until mitigations validated.

Alex Ruiz: Quick action list: Maria (obs & alerts) EOD Thu; Kevin (runtime canary & KV tracing) Fri AM; Alex (client SDK guidance + short-term rate-limiter tweak) target Wed next week; Sarah (comms) Fri. All update INC-9821 with checkboxes.

oncall-bot: Created incident ticket INC-9821 and assigned to #incidents.

Kevin Choi: Sample gap log:
```
[2026-03-20T14:22:10Z] s=abc chunk=5
[2026-03-20T14:22:11Z] s=abc chunk=6
[2026-03-20T14:22:14Z] s=abc chunk=7  <-- gap 3s
[2026-03-20T14:22:18Z] s=abc chunk=8
```
I'll run canary tomorrow and post results here.

Maria Ng: I'll also run a synthetic: 1k concurrent sessions at 1t/s to surface backpressure and correlate gaps to node_id/model_variant.

Alex Ruiz: If canary shows improvement, we'll release an SDK note recommending reconnect jitter + capped exponential backoff and reduce rate-limiter aggression for warm sessions.

Kevin Choi: ACK. Posting canary diff + traces once available.

Maria Ng: ACK. Dashboard link will be posted when ready.

Sarah Li: ACK. Draft comms will be ready to iterate after results.

Alex Ruiz: Next sync Mon 11:00 PT. Escalate to infra if node_id correlations or cross-region pattern emerges.
